scan_targets.description: List of IP addresses, CIDR subnets, or hostnames to scan. Supports wildcards (e.g., 192.168.*.*) and ranges (e.g., 10.0.0.1-10.0.0.5).

items.description: Single target (IP, subnet, hostname, or wildcard expression).

interface.description: Network interface to bind to (e.g., eth0, enp3s0). If empty, uses default route interface.

timeout_ms.description: Per-packet timeout in milliseconds before retransmitting.

retries.description: Number of times to retransmit a packet if no response received.

transid.description: Transaction ID (8-hex-char string) for IKE Main Mode exchanges. Useful for testing or evading simple stateless filters.

vendor_fingerprint.description: Enable vendor fingerprinting by extracting and comparing vendor IDs in IKE responses against a local database.

nat_t_detection.description: Enable NAT-T detection by sending NAT-D payloads and analyzing responses for NAT traversal support.

verbose.description: Enable verbose output to display detailed IKE proposals, transforms, and payload contents.

extra_options.description: Additional ike-scan CLI options as a single space-separated string (e.g., '--quiet --plainpsk --p1unit').
